outcome_summary: The plan extracted a shared useDebounce hook, performed a comprehensive i18n pass across SaveDataViewer, ShipLossesView, and OwnedShipsView, stripped the _macro suffix from the StationsView Type column, and removed the resolved Known Limitations constraint entry. All 7 work packages passed all 4 pipeline stages with zero rework cycles; 10/10 tests passed and TypeScript reported zero errors throughout. Key deferred items include a follow-up i18n WP for ~18 remaining hardcoded strings and a fetch-cancellation WP to address the double-fetch/AbortController gap in two components.
